name: Compiler Engineer
description: Build compilers, interpreters, and language tools. Implement lexers, parsers, AST walkers, type checkers, and code generators.
example_snippet:
program ASTNode:
    shape Expr holds:
        method eval produces whole number:
            produce success with 0
        end method
    end shape

    shape Number is a Expr holds:
        Value as whole number

        method eval produces whole number:
            produce success with Value
        end method
    end shape

    shape Add is a Expr holds:
        Left as unique handle to Expr
        Right as unique handle to Expr

        method eval produces whole number:
            produce success with the sum of call Left.eval and call Right.eval
        end method
    end shape

    keep Expr1 as unique handle to Number with new Number with 5
    keep Expr2 as unique handle to Number with new Number with 3
    keep Sum as unique handle to Add with new Add with Expr1 and Expr2

    keep Result as whole number
    call Sum.eval giving Result
    print the text "5 + 3 = " and Result and newline
end program
